name: BeanstalkFarms
fix_description: In emergencyCommit (and governance voting), use snapshot-based voting power instead of current token balance. Flash-loaned tokens should not count as voting power. Require votes to be locked/delegated for a minimum period before they can be used, preventing single-transaction governance attacks.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct exploit with essentially two core interactions against a single swap contract: buy NST, then sell/abuse the returned amount and pull USDT out. It does not require complex protocol knowledge, multi-contract routing, or sophisticated state reasoning beyond identifying the broken swap/accounting logic.
